def assert_outside_fingerprint_surface(changed_paths: Iterable[str], surface: FingerprintSurface | None = None) -> None: """Refuse a cutover action that edits the evidence-fingerprint surface.

A cutover that modifies these files invalidates every qualification it was about to rely on, so it must fail loudly at the point of the action.
Paths are resolved against the repository before comparison, so a caller that reports a changed file by a slightly different (or wrong) route still gets caught rather than silently passing an unsurfaced path through the check.
Raises `FingerprintSurfaceError` naming the offending paths and the consumers each one would retire. A path that DOES exist is simply new work (Phase F # adds modules every day) and is allowed through. unknown.append(str(raw)) else: changed.append(label)
